translation.title: Zipaquirá and Guatavita from Bogotá: Salt Cathedral and El Dorado
translation.lead: Travel from Bogotá to Lake Guatavita, associated with the legend of El Dorado, stroll through Guatavita town and visit the underground Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá.
notes: Ada Tours may adjust the order of visits when necessary.

translation.body:
Leave Bogotá for Lake Guatavita in the Andean highlands, a place closely linked with the legend of El Dorado. A walk through the reserve introduces you to the mountain landscape before the journey continues to the town of Guatavita.

There is free time for lunch at a local restaurant. Lunch is paid for separately.

In the afternoon, visit the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá, carved approximately 180 metres underground in a former salt mine. Underground chapels, galleries and monumental halls form the heart of the visit. Afterwards, return to Bogotá.
